paragraphs: Now open and excited to serve the community. Your trusted dentist in Harrisburg, NC, offering compassionate, convenient family dentistry.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort. We're your trusted dentist in Harrisburg, NC, for compassionate care.
Comprehensive dental care for every member of your family. From routine cleanings to advanced treatments, we provide exceptional care with the latest technology and techniques.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

As your trusted dentist in Harrisburg, NC, our experienced team of dental professionals is dedicated to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

Our patients at Riccobene Family Dentistry’s location in Harrisburg, NC describe us best - we don’t like to brag, but we love how often the word ‘amazing’ shows up in our reviews. Our modern, welcoming and state-of-the-art facilities are the perfect location for our expertly trained, compassionate staff that make providing exceptional dentistry for your whole family their mission.

You’ll find us conveniently located near I-485 off Rocky River Rd., just east of Charlotte. The Riccobene team has 25 years of experience delivering dental care that goes above and beyond, guided by the fact that we’re part of your community - we live, work and play in the Harrisburg, Rocky River, Allen and Wildwoods community, so the smiles we help create and maintain are the ones we see every day.

We believe in the Riccobene Way - a commitment to deliver better dentistry, better experiences, and better results with a comprehensive and compassionate approach. Our expert dentist in Harrisburg, NC is dedicated to providing the highest standard of care to ensure a positive dental experience for every patient.
When you help a lot of people you get to some large numbers that we’re proud of - each satisfied patient is another happy smile.
Can't make it to our Charlotte office? We have other convenient locations in the area to serve you with the same exceptional dental care.
Quality dental care should be accessible to everyone. We offer flexible payment options, accept most insurance plans, and provide affordable membership plans for uninsured patients.
Save money on dental care with our affordable annual membership plans. No insurance? No problem! Get the care you need at a price you can afford.
Yes - we’re accepting new patients. Book an appointment online, give us a call, or fill out the form below and we’ll get you scheduled for an appointment.

Teeth whitening is one of the most popular cosmetic procedures we offer at our Harrisburg location. Give us a call today and we’ll get you booked for a consultation to see how much whiter we can help you make your smile, often in as little as once visit.
Yes - implants are an option at the Harrisburg location, or we can refer you to other Riccobene locations for more complicated oral surgery if required.

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Prior to any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.
There are three ways to schedule your appointment with us at Riccobene Family Dentistry in our Harrisburg office. Give us a call, contact us using the form below, or book an appointment online.

You can expect caring, compassionate and comprehensive dental care on every visit to Riccobene, especially your first. We’ll get to know you and your dental history, understand any immediate concerns you have, and make a plan to address those concerns. Whether you’re seeing us for a routine dental cleaning or to start exploring more complicated dental concerns, we can help.

Yes - we take pride in providing excellent dental care for the whole family. You’ll see it on our reviews - we often see a whole family, and we love receiving holiday cards, wedding announcements, or just family photos where every smile we see is one that we’ve helped care for.

Knowing what dental care you need can be tricky, particularly when it comes to complicated solutions like dental implants. Luckily, Riccobene’s experienced, credentialed dentists can answer the question of what to do for missing or damaged teeth for you - sometimes this will be implants, but we’ll do a detailed examination and consultation to be sure what treatment is best for you.
Take the first step towards optimal oral health. Contact our Charlotte office to schedule your appointment or ask any questions about our dental services.
Fill out the form below and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.

Call our Harrisburg Office at 980-825-7382, or use the form below to request an appointment.

schemaMarkup.reviewBody: A lovely office with a friendly staff and the latest technology used by highly skilled doctors - I've been a client for 20 years and can't imagine changing.

I had an excellent experience at this dentist office. The customer service was outstanding—friendly and efficient from start to finish. I was able to get a same-day appointment to have a crown repaired, and the work was done with impressive professionalism. It’s such a relief to have a trusted dentist here. Highly recommended!

After years of ducking the dentist I finally decided to go, I was nervous because who knows what they are going to tell me and that sharp hook tool makes me uneasy lol. The staff was so warm and inviting and the dental assistant really helped me relax and not worry. Fast forward to 6 months after my first visit my gums are healthy and teeth looking better than ever. Best dentist office ever!!!

Our family had a the BEST experience at the dentist today! Our hygienist, Brooke, was absolutely amazing—gentle, thorough, and made us all feel incredibly comfortable and beautiful cleaned us up. Gina at the front desk was just as fantastic—welcoming, kind, and so helpful. The entire team was kind, patient, and made us feel comfortable from start to finish. Highly recommend!

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Are you accepting new patients at your Harrisburg office?

Yes - we’re accepting new patients. Book an appointment online, give us a call, or fill out the form below and we’ll get you scheduled for an appointment.

Can I get teeth whitening at the Harrisburg location?

Teeth whitening is one of the most popular cosmetic procedures we offer at our Harrisburg location. Give us a call today and we’ll get you booked for a consultation to see how much whiter we can help you make your smile, often in as little as once visit.

Does your Harrisburg office provide dental implants?

Yes - implants are an option at the Harrisburg location, or we can refer you to other Riccobene locations for more complicated oral surgery if required.

Does Riccobene Associates in Harrisburg accept insurance?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Prior to any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

How can I schedule an appointment with a dentist in Harrisburg?

There are three ways to schedule your appointment with us at Riccobene Family Dentistry in our Harrisburg office. Give us a call, contact us using the form below, or book an appointment online.

What should I expect during my first dental visit?

You can expect caring, compassionate and comprehensive dental care on every visit to Riccobene, especially your first. We’ll get to know you and your dental history, understand any immediate concerns you have, and make a plan to address those concerns. Whether you’re seeing us for a routine dental cleaning or to start exploring more complicated dental concerns, we can help.

Do you provide family dentistry in Harrisburg, NC?

Yes - we take pride in providing excellent dental care for the whole family. You’ll see it on our reviews - we often see a whole family, and we love receiving holiday cards, wedding announcements, or just family photos where every smile we see is one that we’ve helped care for.

How do I know if I need dental implants?

Knowing what dental care you need can be tricky, particularly when it comes to complicated solutions like dental implants. Luckily, Riccobene’s experienced, credentialed dentists can answer the question of what to do for missing or damaged teeth for you - sometimes this will be implants, but we’ll do a detailed examination and consultation to be sure what treatment is best for you.
